scientific_limitations: The accepted contribution is the pairwise metric reconstruction and affine-similarity interpretation, not the classical constant-sum Viviani theorem.
An equivalent formula may exist in older barycentric-coordinate, simplex-coordinate, or frame-theoretic literature under different terminology; the search was not historically exhaustive.
The 2026 Alhajjar–Nasta article was inspected at abstract/reference level rather than in full text, so a hidden equivalent statement there cannot be ruled out from the inspected material alone.
title: Facet-distance coordinates are a scaled Euclidean isometry in regular simplices
